settings.title: Settings
settings.keysHint: A key is submitted once over HTTPS, stored encrypted server-side, never kept or echoed here; revoke any time.
settings.threadHint: New sessions carry this model and approval policy.

policy.on-request: On request: ask when Codex asks
policy.on-failure: On failure: ask only when the sandbox fails

settings.sandboxHint: Start a Codex sandbox of your own in the cloud with the model key you registered; the first start prints your local agent command once.
settings.sandboxCapacityFull: Cloud sandboxes are at capacity right now. Please try again later; your key and settings are kept.
settings.rotateHint: The old tokens are revoked at the relay right away; the new command is shown once and a running sandbox rolls automatically.
settings.noticeProvisioned: Started: the sandbox is booting and will show "Running" in a minute or two. Copy and keep the command below; it is shown only once.
settings.noticeUpdated: Updated: the sandbox restarts with the new settings (about a minute), showing "Starting" then "Running". Your local agent needs nothing.
settings.noticeRestored: Restored: the sandbox is starting and your earlier work is kept. Your local agent does not need to reconnect.
settings.noticeDeleted: Removed: the sandbox is stopped and your work is kept. Start it again any time; no new command will be issued.
settings.noticeRotated: Rotated: the old token is revoked and your local agent was disconnected. Reconnect it with the new command below, then start it.
settings.confirmRotate: Rotating revokes the old token right away and disconnects your running local agent; you will reconnect it with a new command. The sandbox and your work are not affected. Rotate now?
settings.confirmDelete: Removing stops the sandbox (your work is kept) and sessions pause until you start it again. Remove it?
settings.copied: Copied. Paste and keep it on your computer now; it will not be shown again.
settings.copyManual: Your browser blocked copying; the whole command is selected, press Ctrl+C (⌘+C on Mac).
settings.agentTokenHint: Copy it to your machine and run it; the token is never shown again. If lost, remove the sandbox and start again.

workbench.agentOffline: The local agent is not connected or not installed. Run `sunmoon-agent start` on your machine and it appears here; browsing and settings still work.
